set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 4.

Problem:
RemoteAwaitPolicy.default (ssh/RemoteTask.scala:18-21) is a 1000 ms poll with a 24 h timeout. ADR 0003 deliberately uses one ssh process (and one remote agent JVM) per request. RemoteTaskHandle.poll (:109-141) issues readResult and, on Pending, terminalAccounting -> sacct. That is two ssh spawns plus two remote JVM starts per second for up to ~172,000 iterations, including sacct at 1 Hz against a shared accounting database.

The transport decision is sound; the default cadence contradicts its documented cost.

Acceptance:
- Default poll interval raised to a site-safe value with bounded exponential backoff up to a ceiling.
- Accounting checked on a distinctly slower cadence than the result read, not on every Pending.
- Both cadences are explicit, documented, and caller-overridable.
- Tests assert backoff growth and that accounting is not invoked on every poll.
set.title: P6f.31: Align default remote await cadence with the per-request SSH transport
